docs/format-notes.md committed as e13629b on wt/formatnotes. Full empirical scan of ~/.claude/projects on 2026-08-19: 48 project dirs, 871 JSONL files, 169,775 lines, 754.7 MB. Encoding rule derived from real cwd fields and verified on 41/48 dirs: every non-[A-Za-z0-9] char -> a single '-', case preserved; LOSSY and non-injective (/ . _ + and literal - all collapse), so --repo must encode forward and never decode. 19 line kinds tabulated with counts; assistant 85031 / user 49039 carry cwd+timestamp+role+content, the other 15 kinds never carry cwd and 12 never carry a timestamp; journal.jsonl holds only started/result and is the sole source of the 29 zero-cwd files. Pathologies: 0 bad lines, 0 truncated tails, 0 empty files, but 12 lines >=1MB and one of 16.4MB. Time: RFC3339 UTC ms, non-monotonic in 246/842 files (worst inversion 12h), mtime never precedes the last turn (0/842) so mtime pruning is sound but can overshoot by 22 days. Biggest finding, sent to orchestrator as pact-msg-87adb6361c3ba806: cwd is the process cwd, so pact-style wt/<agent> worktrees never appear in it and the spec's invoked_from->worktree->cwd join does not resolve for the fleet recount audits; the transcript-mention signal and the subagent .meta.json description must be the primary keys.

Implemented prune::partition mtime windowing in src/prune.rs (commit 4c103d7, branch wt/prune). Lower bound only: mtime < window.since proves every turn predates the window (append-only => mtime bounds the LAST turn), so the file is skipped unopened; window.until never prunes, since mtime never bounds the FIRST turn — module doc states the asymmetry explicitly and cites docs/format-notes.md §6.2 (842 files, min 0.0s, median 0.1s, zero inversions; overshoot p99 ~30h / max 22.72d from timestamp-less resume metadata, safe downward, fatal upward). No since (unbounded or upper-bounded only) => everything opened, zero stat calls. Unreadable metadata (deleted mid-scan, permission denied) => opened, not skipped: uncertainty resolves toward looking. Satisfies docs/spec.md lines 19-20 'sessions are append-only, so mtime prunes files outside the query window unopened'. Acceptance test proves unopened by opens not timing: pruned fixture is mode 000 (any File::open errors) plus a candidate that does not exist; verified by sabotage — inserting a File::open into partition fails the test. mtimes set explicitly via File::set_times. Published signatures Partition{opened,skipped} and partition(candidates,window) unchanged. fmt/clippy -D warnings/test all green (14 tests). Not merged — orchestrator lands wt/prune at the wave barrier.

resolve() implemented in src/join.rs, commit 7016abb (branch wt/join). Scores the spec's three signals (docs/spec.md L41-47 'The join (the whole point)'): topological chain invoked_from -> worktree path -> session cwd via worktree::for_cwd; time-window overlap as a hard gate (no overlap = Refusal::NoOverlap, never a low score); transcript mention of the PACT_AGENT name or bead id, matched on word boundaries. Every outcome explains itself: Match{confidence, non-empty evidence} or one of the two refusals, distinguished (no cwd match vs no overlap) with a detail naming what was examined. AMENDMENT: degeneracy is detected from the data — Topology::{ProcessPerAgent, Ambiguous, SubagentPerAgent, Unnamed}, degenerate unless exactly one surviving candidate cwd names the queried worktree. When degenerate, topology scores 0.2 (filter) instead of 0.5 (discriminator), the mention becomes decisive, and the observed regime is named in the Topology evidence string. Topology B tops out at 0.65 with a mention and 0.40 without (below CONFIDENT=0.5, so at refuses). 13 unit tests, incl. the pinned topology-B case (three sessions, identical cwd, overlapping windows, mention-only discrimination), each signal in isolation, both refusals, the pruned worktree, and an invariant test that no outcome is ever bare. cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings + 52 tests green.

Commit 1b642167c3540333bbd2d29795d787b28523c833 on wt/honesty.

SessionMeta gains `declined: usize` beside `parse_failures`, which keeps its
name and now means only DAMAGE. No field removed, renamed or repurposed.
`declined` = the connector could have read the line and chose not to (over the
size cap, or a shape it does not take); `parse_failures` = it tried and could
not. A line kind a connector simply does not read (claude_code's 10,309
attachments, its other fifteen types) is in neither — that is the format's
structure, not a loss, and tallying it would drown the numbers that matter.

claude_code: an over-cap line increments `declined`. generic_jsonl: the split is
exactly whether serde_json succeeded — valid JSON that is not turn-shaped is
declined, a line that is not JSON is damaged. doctor emits two findings, each
naming its tally, and the decline finding says "0 damaged" out loud when there
is none. sessions carries `declined` in JSON and digest; envelope and the
stdout-document / stderr-digest split are untouched, no schema bump (additive).

Also fixed the two false statements in claude_code's module doc that §5/§5.1
contradicted: "twelve real lines exceed 1 MB" (31 do; 12 exceed 10 MB) and "a
pasted binary dump" for the 8 MB line, which is the human's own prompt.

    - connector claude_code: 12 lines declined across 6 of 831 sessions —

Which is true: 12 declined, 0 damaged, across the same 6 files §5.1 identified.
The word "unparseable" and the claim "those transcripts are damaged" are gone.

at implemented in src/cmd/at.rs (commit b1181ee, branch wt/cmdat). Applies join's CONFIDENT (0.5) threshold — join returns the best candidate with its score and leaves the bar to at — giving three outcomes behind the spec's two exit codes: match (exit 0: session + confidence + evidence + transcript window), low_confidence (exit 1: session + confidence + evidence, transcript withheld, explicitly NOT one of the two reasons), refused (exit 1: reason is Refusal::reason(), 'no cwd match' or 'no overlap', plus detail). Spec lines: 'recount at --repo

--agent --ts [--window 5m] ... Exit 0 found / 1 no-confident-match with the reason (no cwd match vs no overlap)' and 'Scored match that always reports confidence and evidence, never a bare answer' — no code path prints an answer without both, in either stream. --window defaults to 5m and is half-width each side via TimeWindow::around, asserted both directions. Output follows cmd/sessions.rs: envelope {command,schema,...}, --json to stdout alone with the digest second on stderr. Discovery is windowed (mtime prune, 43ms) then repeated unwindowed only when the cheap pass refuses on topology, because the prune otherwise turns a real 'no overlap' into a false 'no cwd match' (110ms on that path). 10 new tests, 90 green, clippy -D warnings clean. explain calls at::run(&AtArgs, json) -> Result, or at::run_with(&AtArgs, invoked_from, bead, json) to pass the event's invoked_from and bead id into the join.
